messages:
leah: Quick kickoff  launch posts + webinar funnel SEO. Need owner for keyword mapping, schema snippets, internal links, redirects, and CTA anchors. Who's in?

arjun: I can take canonical + redirects. Plan: one landing per intent, 301 legacy posts -> canonical, preserve UTM query params, mark experiment routes as 302. Will post CSV.

marta: I'll own structured data: Event for webinar, FAQPage for the benchmark, BreadcrumbList on landing. Will produce CMS-ready snippets.

carlos: Analytics: use utm_content for CTA variants (`webinar_cta`, `bench_cta`, `kit_cta`). Event names: `cta_click`, `register_submit`, `lead_complete`. Thank-you pages = `noindex`.

arjun: Redirect examples (nginx):
```
# article -> new launch landing
rewrite ^/articles/old-launch/(.*)$ /launch-2026/$1 permanent;
# avoid chaining: convert intermediate redirects to direct 301s
```
I'll flag any temporary 302 experiments.

marta: Event schema snippet I'll drop in CMS: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Scaled Serving webinar","startDate":"2026-06-12T17:00:00Z","eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"}}
```
And FAQ `mainEntity` for the benchmark.

leah: Internal linking: add 2 contextual links from product docs, 3 from benchmark post to landing. Use anchors: "Register", "Read benchmark", "Get starter kit". No links to thank-you pages.

carlos: Also ensure canonical tag on LP normalizes query params. Post-deploy run a link equity check and flatten any chains >1 hop.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for branch `marketing/webinar-funnel`  preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/launch-2026-preview. Running staging crawl + lighthouse.

arjun: After staging crawl I'll share results. If any 3xx chains >1 we'll flatten to single 301s.

marta: Reminder: FAQ on benchmark should include the top 6 Qs to help rich results.

leah: Ownership recap: arjun = redirects + canonicals; marta = schema + snippets; carlos = UTMs + events; leah = signoff + CRO. Sync tomorrow 10am to review staging crawl. :calendar:
